The topology_boundary_auditor's mask confidence of 0.8699 is decent but not perfect, suggesting some boundary issues. I would increase the structural_collapse severity to 2.5. Additionally, I notice some minor issues with the decorative elements at the top of the organ case - the gold trim appears slightly inconsistent in thickness and pattern, which could be another texture_anomaly or structural issue. I would add a minor artifact for this.
